Container.Name: aria-garmin-sync
Container.Overview: Syncs Fitbit Aria weigh-ins (weight + body fat) from the Google Health API to Garmin Connect. Google and Garmin tokens live in /data (google_client_secret.json, google_token.json, garmin_tokens.json).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for logs and Slack messages

Config.Name: Slack webhook URL
Config.Description: Incoming webhook for the alerts channel (overrides .env)

Config.Name: Webhook port
Config.Description: Webhook receiver. Exposed publicly only through the container's Tailscale Funnel.

Config.Name: Webhook path
Config.Description: From `aria-sync webhook-secret`, e.g. /hook/<random>. Leave blank to disable webhooks.

Config.Name: Webhook secret
Config.Description: Full Authorization header value Google sends, e.g. Bearer <random>

Config.Name: Poll interval (s)
Config.Description: Seconds between Google Health polls (a safety net; webhooks trigger syncs immediately)
